item.title: Kosciusko County Auditor Offers Updates On Tax Deductions, Exemptions, Credits
item.description: Kosciusko County Auditor Alyssa Schmucker would like to make taxpayers aware of changes in deductions, exemptions and credits that were approved this year by the Indiana General Assembly.

item.title: Silver Lake Town Council Discusses USDA Bond Options
item.description: A summary of proposed options for a United States Department of Agriculture bond was presented to the Silver Lake Town Council at their year-end meeting on Monday, Dec. 29.

item.title: Dalton Corporation In Warsaw To Close Its Doors By March 2026
item.description: Dalton Corporation in Warsaw announced Monday, Dec. 29, they will be permanently closing their doors effective March 1, 2026.

item.title: Claypool Council Approves Baker Tilly Contract
item.description: The Claypool Town Council approved its annual contract with Baker Tilly and a resolution for the town marshal's standard operating procedures during a year-end meeting on Monday, Dec. 29.

item.title: Now Through Wednesday – 15% Off In-Stock Furniture at Brouwer’s
item.description: Brouwer’s Flooring & Furniture is wrapping up the year with special savings. Now through Wednesday, customers can take 15% off all in-stock furniture during the End-of-Year Sale.
